description.value: 101 Canada Boba is a Metro Vancouver grab-and-go bubble tea chain founded in 2020, offering fruit teas, milk teas, and bubble waffles crafted with premium ingredients—70% of which are imported directly from Taiwan. Operating six locations across Vancouver, Burnaby, and Richmond, the brand is known for fast, consistent service and a rotating seasonal menu including a new Matcha Series. Founded during the COVID-19 pandemic, it has grown to become a local favourite with over 80% customer return rates.
